description: This file contains platform-specific upgrade scripts for various hardware devices in the OpenWRT project, including functions for checking images, performing upgrades, and handling device-specific upgrade procedures.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks the integrity and status of the firmware image before upgrade based on the device's board name.

methods.name: askey_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs upgrade for Askey devices by extracting root filesystem from the provided tar file.

methods.name: zyxel_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs upgrade for Zyxel devices by extracting kernel and root filesystem from the tar file.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_mikrotik_nand
methods.description: Handles upgrade process specifically for MikroTik devices with NAND storage.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Main function orchestrating device-specific upgrade procedures based on board name.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies configuration to specific device types after upgrade, if applicable.
